name: Holy Warmage (Warmage Archetype)
body:
Sometimes divine magic is insufficient in the divine struggles that bleed over into the mortal planes. In steps the holy warmage, an arcane sword in the hands of their faith.

Alignment: A holy warmage’s alignment must be within one step of their deity’s or faith’s.

Alignment Dedication (Ex)

A holy warmage cannot cast spells with alignment descriptors that they or their faith share. If the holy warmage or their faith share an alignment with the spell cast, the CL is increased by 1.

Arcane Strategies (Ex)

A holy warmage gains access to the following arcane strategies:

Faith Magic: You add a spell available on the domain spell list of a domain available to your deity or faith to each spell level you possess or later gain, of your spell list. The spell must still be learned and added to your spellbook before it can be used. This arcane strategy can be selected multiple times, granting new spells for each level from a different domain.
Theurge: You gain the 1st-level powers of a domain available to your deity or faith. For this ability you treat your warmage level as your effective cleric level and your Intelligence modifier in place of any ability score for DC or variables. This arcane strategy can be selected multiple times, granting a new 1st-level domain ability from a different domain available to your deity or faith.
Divine Hammer (Su)

At 2nd level, a holy warmage uses their evocation spells as a hammer against their foes. All evocation spells cast on a creature whose alignment is not within one step of the holy warmage’s faith deal an extra point of damage per spell level. This increases by 1 at 9th and 16th levels. This ability replaces focused mind.

Spell Smite (Su)

At 5th level, a holy warmage is able to call down a smite upon a target who is an enemy of their deity or faith. Against that target, the warmage may add their Charisma to attack rolls and saving throws of their spells and 1/2 their level to the damage.

The holy warmage gains another use at 11th and 17th levels. This ability replaces the arcane strategies gained at 5th, 11th, and 16th levels.

Devoted Arcanist (Ex)

At 9th level, a holy warmage adds 1/2 their class level to caster level checks to overcome the spell resistance of creatures whose alignment is more than one step from the holy warmage’s faith. This ability replaces the arcane strategy gained at 9th level.
